devices.name: Wi-Fi Router
devices.description: Black rectangular Wi-Fi router with a circular logo. On the rear: a row of four yellow RJ45 sockets printed LAN 1 to LAN 4, with a separate RJ45 socket immediately to their left.

devices.name: PlayStation 5
devices.description: Original Sony PlayStation 5 console (standard model, not Slim or Pro): tall console with white outer covers around a black centre body. Rear connections per Sony: one LAN port, one HDMI OUT port, two USB Type-A ports and an AC IN power connector.

devices.name: Samsung Television
devices.description: Large black Samsung television. Its rear/side connection panel has three HDMI-shaped inputs with two USB-A-style ports above them.

requirements.text: Connect the PlayStation 5 to the Wi-Fi router using an Ethernet cable plugged into any valid router LAN port and the PS5 LAN port.
Connect the PlayStation 5 HDMI OUT port to any valid HDMI input on the Samsung television.
